# Draco glTF decoder

These three unmodified decoder artifacts were copied from
`three@0.183.0/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/` on 2026-09-13.

Upstream: https://github.com/google/draco

License: Apache 2.0, included in `LICENSE` from the upstream repository.
Only runtime decoders are included; the encoder is not shipped to visitors.
The Sopro viewer uses this local directory instead of the default external CDN.
